TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Merc. sul.]
Soreness on tip of tongue.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Merc. sul.]
Stools loose, watery, causing severe burning and soreness of anus.
Very profuse watery evacuations (relieving dyspnœa). θ Hydrothorax.
Violent purging ; rice water motions, some yellow.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Merc. sul.]
Gonorrhœa or syphilis, with intense congestion to parts.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Merc. sul.]
Increased expectoration of mucus from larynx and trachea.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Merc. sul.]
Great dyspnœa ; has to sit ; cannot lie down ; breathing quick and short. θ Hydrothorax.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Merc. sul.]
Burning in chest.
Hydrothorax ; dyspnœa, breathing quick and short, has to sit, cannot lie down ; swollen extremities ; stools loose, watery, causing severe burning and soreness of anus ; burning in chest. [Obs. "When it acts well it produces a profuse, watery diarrhœa with great relief to patient. It is as important as Arsen. in hydrothorax." --Lippe.].
Dropsy of chest, especially if occurring from heart or liver disease.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Merc. sul.]
Œdematous swelling of legs.
   

FEVER. [40] [Merc. sul.]
Excessive sweat at night.
